messages:
Anna Chen: Heads-up: finalizing the release brief for the docs site — planning to ship the relnotes and changelog update tomorrow 10:00am PT. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3450 Please confirm current blocks: snippet regressions, embeddings migration guide, and redirect map. @Jess P. can you sanity-check the SDK examples?

docs-bot: Automated check: broken-link-scan started for branch release/v1.10 — 12 potential 404s found (details in CI).

Mike R.: I'll take the snippet matrix. One Python embeddings example needs updating: client.embedding_embeddings -> client.embeddings.create (API rename). Marking as "patch required" in the PR.

Jess P.: On it. Quick note — the JS streaming example uses old param names. I'll push a tiny PR to normalize to streaming: true and add the new error-handling block. ETA ~1h.

Samir Patel: Known issue to call out in relnotes: LLM routing fallback can cause a noticeable latency bump when region fallback triggers. Recommend callers pin model version or set fallback: none for latency-sensitive paths. Also add rollout note for Dedicated customers.

Anna Chen: :thumbsup: Samir — please add a compact config snippet for the suggested mitigation. Mike, can you also include a table of affected SDK versions in the brief?

Mike R.: Added a snippet_matrix.csv to the PR with columns: file, language, current_api, needed_change, test_status. Example row: docs/sdk/python/embeddings.md, python, client.embedding_embeddings, client.embeddings.create, failing. Pushing now.

oliver: Re: redirects — we'll need a redirect rule for /docs/old-embeddings -> /docs/guides/embeddings-migration. I can add a Netlify redirect after merge. Suggest keep old slug active in page header for 30 days for search/links.

Jess P.: Pushed fixes: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3457 — normalized JS example, added error handling. Could not reproduce one CI link failure locally; might be cached index.

docs-bot: CI status: link-scan complete — 3 remaining failures: two external vendor links and one internal anchor mismatch in /docs/rollouts.md#canary-vs-ab-test.

Anna Chen: For the vendor links, add a short known-issue blurb: "third-party model repo downloads may intermittently fail; use retries/backoff and mirror artifacts when possible." Include anchor fix in rollouts.md. Keep relnotes blurb concise.

Mike R.: Test plan for snippets: run smoke/docs-runner against staging runtime. If embeddings snippet fails, we'll add a migration diff code block and a "how to test" step in the doc. Example diff to include:

```diff
- response = client.embedding_embeddings(input)
+ response = client.embeddings.create(input)
```

Jess P.: One more item: callout for Dedicated customers — "If you use reserved capacity, check model pinning before upgrade; auto-fallback settings may cause cross-instance routing." Samir, please ack the wording so we can add to the brief.

Samir Patel: Ack. I'll add a short FAQ entry and a recommended command to inspect routing policy: `redwoodctl routing get --project=acme`.

Anna Chen: Great. Final ask: who can publish the release brief tomorrow 10:00am PT and watch the docs deploy? @oliver?

oliver: I can. I'll monitor Netlify and rollback the redirect if we see traffic spikes. Will post an announcement in #announcements when live.

Anna Chen: Thanks all. I'll merge when CI is green and then send the relnotes draft to the newsletter list.
